purpose: Transfer durable findings into RHAstra without importing proof claims or exploratory overconfidence.

statuses.SURVIVES: Reusable identity, theorem, rigorous finite result, or reproducible structural observation.
statuses.OPEN: Promising formulation with an unresolved proof-level obstacle.
statuses.KILLED: Route falsified or structurally invalid in the legacy work.
statuses.CIRCULAR: Decisive step was found to encode essentially the same difficulty as RH.

findings.title: Weil explicit-formula barrier reconstruction
findings.caveat: Known zero/prime information is part of the calibration; never score as independent discovery.

findings.title: Even/odd parity decomposition
findings.caveat: Should be exact; failure indicates implementation error.

findings.title: Lorentzian signature conjecture
findings.caveat: Not a proof shortcut; arithmetic content appears RH-hard.

findings.title: Finite interval verification of odd-block negativity
Near-zero critical direction and extreme cancellation
findings.caveat: Generic loose norm bounds are unlikely to resolve a 1e-7 to 1e-8 margin.

findings.title: Cramer primes destroy signature
findings.caveat: Shows prime specificity, not why actual primes succeed.

findings.title: Generic margin-drain concentration
findings.caveat: Do not assume independent/noise-like prime phases can close the needed bound.

findings.title: Naive heat-kernel/modular shortcut
findings.caveat: Require out-of-sample improvement beyond the exact explicit-formula baseline.

findings.title: ESPRIT recovery of approximate zero frequencies
findings.caveat: Frequency recovery is not spectral completeness or RH evidence.

findings.title: Operator lift K_odd = D + H
findings.caveat: Domain, principal-value kernel, boundedness and self-adjointness require fresh proofs.

findings.title: Gauge-symmetry no-go theorem
findings.caveat: Recheck hypotheses for every candidate; theorem applies only when t-dependence is removable by unitary conjugation.

findings.title: Spectral completeness obstacle
findings.caveat: Numerical trajectory-to-zero matching cannot substitute for completeness.

findings.title: Finite-T arithmetic corrections to GUE pair statistics
findings.caveat: Independent reproduction required before becoming a gate.

findings.title: Peak-gap eigenvector rigidity
findings.caveat: Independent reproduction and a carefully matched random-matrix control are required.
